newsitem.title: OMAN: Bank Muscat Al Ahli in $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank Muscat Al Ahli in $50 mln loan.

text.p: Bank Muscat Al Ahli Al Omani said on Wednesday it was borrowing $50 million from the international market through a syndicated loan.
A bank official told Reuters the five-year loan was being arranged by 20 banks, led by Societe Generale and HSBC.
The deal would be signed in London on July 25 with drawdown within a month, the official said.
The pricing of the loan was "very attractive", he said, but declined to give its margin over LIBOR.
"It will be used mainly to meet our short- and medium-term lending requirements," he said.
"The growing industrialisation and privatisation of infrastructure facilities provide fertile ground for medium-term lending opportunities in Oman," the bank said in a statement.
Bank Muscat Al Ahli Al Omani had gone to the market planning to raise $30 million, but after banks offered to lend $77 million, the loan was increased to $50 million, it said.
